newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower in lacklustre day.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower in lacklustre day.

text.p: Sweden's stockmarket closed lower on Thursday, snubbing gains in the U.S. from the open and trading weaker all day in a lacklustre market.
The Stockholm general index fell 0.46 percent to 2,141.04 after fairly healthy trade volumes worth 4.7 billion crowns changed owners.
Brokers were unable to pinpoint any specific reason for the weakness but said it could be nervousness that Wall Street may change direction soon after post-election gains.
Drugs major Astra slipped 4.50 crowns to 294.50 crowns.
Fellow blue chip Ericsson gained two to 192 crowns.
Ericsson announced a two billion crown deal with AT&T of the U.S. on Thursday and a 1.8 billion crown China order.
Bus and truck maker Scania tumbled 9.0 crowns to 167 crowns after posting a disappointing nine month report in which profit after financial items fell by 39 percent.
Retailer Hennes & Mauritz posted good gains, jumping 24 crowns to 935 crowns.
